about: Cases for the owner's line after restarts on update: the protocol's updateRestartLine (packages/protocol/src/wake-decision.ts) and the Mac's UpdateRestartLine.swift must both give `line` (null: nothing is said). Checked by apps/bridge/test/supervisor/swift-parity.test.ts and UpdateRestartLineTests.swift.

cases.name: one restarted
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: restarted Trip.

cases.name: two restarted
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: restarted Trip, Garden.

cases.name: one waiting
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: Trip restarts when its turn ends.

cases.name: two waiting
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: Trip, Garden restart when their turns end.

cases.name: one failed
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: Trip failed.

cases.name: all three
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: restarted A, B; C restarts when its turn ends; D failed.

cases.name: line breaks in a name are one space
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: restarted Tr ip, Ga rden; x y restarts when its turn ends.

cases.name: non-ASCII names
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: restarted Reise 🙂; 日本 failed.

cases.name: one not restarted
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: Trip was not restarted (it did not start again).

cases.name: two not restarted
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: Trip, Garden were not restarted (they did not start again).

cases.name: all four
cases.line: Updated or instructions changed: restarted A, B; C restarts when its turn ends; D failed; E was not restarted (it did not start again).
